answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 152936 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Making wudhu after having ghusl Question: I want to ask you if I had routine ghusl as per sunnah but during it I am in nude position not having any izar (complete naked) and after ghusl I am performing salah, so is it necessary to make wudhu after ghusl or I can perform salah just having a ghusl. Please clarify. Answer ID: 152936 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 267/980/SD=10/1438) There is no need to make wudhu after having ghusl though the ghusl is performed completely naked. Hence in the question mentioned above you may offer salah after making ghusl without performing wudhu. It is not necessary to make fresh wudhu due to having ghusl naked. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
